narrative.purpose: Make the ordinary shared ride home visibly inhabited by Xu while preserving the unfilled comfortable silence of familiar neighbors with boundaries. One held image covers the two ride narration beats; the unseen protagonist is present only as the camera viewpoint. This is the uneventful return to 17F after independent checkout and the short walk home, without replaying a prior elevator incident or adding intimacy.
must_show: Exactly one visible adult: Xu Tang, standing naturally in rear three-quarter view with a small readable side contour, facing the closed elevator doors during the ride.
The same apartment elevator cabin: warm overhead light, gray-brown veined stone wall panels/floor, brushed metal closed double doors, metal frames and handrails in their established physical order.

Xu still wears the accepted walk-v3 nighttime casual gray textured long-sleeve button-front home sweater and matching drawstring shorts, large gold hoops, long softly waved brown hair and cream shoulder tote. White casual sneakers follow only Wardrobe A look 2 when visible.

Her own checkout bag still holds her purchased coffee and meal; retain plausible bag/hand continuity, no duplicated separately exposed food or coffee. Calm weight-bearing stance and resting bag grip read as waiting through a normal ride.
must_not_imply: A date, romantic invitation, protective or possessive care, flirtatious look back, bodily contact, sensual display or relationship escalation; no smile aimed at the camera.
An elevator malfunction, flicker, confinement, rescue or repeated earlier elevator scene.
Arrival/open-door action, hallway, 1702 key retrieval or goodbye has already happened. This frame ends before the doors open.
A second visible person, protagonist body/hands/reflection, new passenger, exchanged purchases or shared bags.

That a readable 7 destination or the source panel labels define their destination; the narrative destination is 17F and this is an in-transit frame. Do not present a legible contradictory destination selection.

characters.body_orientation: Rear three-quarter facing the closed doors, turned only slightly toward frame-right so the near ear/hoop and restrained side contour can read; most of the back/hair remains visible. No head turn toward the unseen protagonist or lens.
characters.pose: Ordinary relaxed standing, weight supported naturally by both feet with a slight resting shift. No stride, arched back, leaning on a companion or posing. Cream tote remains on the same shoulder as the accepted walk reference; own checkout bag remains in the corresponding carrying hand, with a natural relaxed grip and enough slight elbow bend to keep grip and bag contents read in the protected region.
characters.gaze: Forward toward the closed door plane, quietly waiting; not toward lens, floor-number display or another person.
characters.expression: Neutral calm, residual late-night fatigue only through relaxed posture. Only a limited side contour is visible; no new acting beat, blush, glamour smile or distress.
held_objects: xu_own_checkout_bag: same unbranded translucent bag carrying purchased black coffee and simple meal, retained from accepted walk-v3 without duplication or hand exchange
cream_shoulder_tote: same cream fabric tote and shoulder placement as accepted walk-v3

environment.time_of_day: Week 2 weekday approximately 23:00, same uninterrupted return home after the convenience store and walk.
environment.weather: Interior sheltered from the recently wet night; no rain or umbrella inside, no new weather event.
environment.lighting: Steady warm recessed overhead elevator illumination and physically plausible soft metal/stone reflections, matching the selected existing cabin. Natural indoor relighting of Xu from the outdoor walk is required by the location change; preserve wardrobe/material/identity, without beauty lighting, dramatic rim light or malfunction.
persistent_props: Same closed brushed-metal double-door pair and center seam, gray-brown stone wall panels and floor, metal trim, two side handrails, warm ceiling light and right-side control-panel housing from the elevator reference. Keep the cabin geometry and material relationships; no hallway, new doors, mirrors or added hardware.

The source panel contains a readable 7 and selected 7 button in its earlier image. Keep the control housing as environment continuity, but subordinate its surface to natural non-focal depth/reflection so no numeral or selected destination is readable in this ride frame. Low-detail stone floor and lower side-wall area provide dialogue-safe background. Reflections stay material reflections; no reflected people or duplicate Xu.

camera.angle: Eye-level toward the existing closed-door plane, level horizon and zero roll. Frame the standing Xu from head through shoes with natural scale; avoid low angle, rear-body emphasis or fashion posing.
camera.camera_side: Unseen protagonist in the rear part of the same cabin, slightly behind and left of Xu, looking toward the doors. Xu stands a comfortable step ahead near center; this is the ordinary indoor spatial transition from the prior side-by-side walk, not a continuation of the outdoor walking axis.
camera.lens_intent: Natural approximately 35-50mm photographic perspective without wide-angle anatomy distortion. Xu hair, limited side contour/earring and bag grip remain clear; enough cabin geometry remains recognizable. Peripheral panel numerals stay non-readable through non-focal optical/material treatment, not artificial pixel blur.
